recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-28100 unless a future work group decision revisits the broad Reference(Resource) build-compatible basedOn representation or chooses to add instantiates through a separate tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-28100 was a Published FHIR-core Security change request resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5. The original workflow-project request asked to expose instantiates, basedOn, and encounter on AuditEvent and Provenance with search parameters, but the accepted resolution narrowed the applied change to basedOn and encounter on both resources with search parameters.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-28100 was found in the relevant source history. Git history shows aa9defa3c842c9dfc93f512695904c954ddb1c7b adding AuditEvent.basedOn, AuditEvent.encounter, Provenance.basedOn, and Provenance.encounter, followed by dd7da5fcf78bd4bafe8e8ba11457a8a8bf9badd6 adding the corresponding based-on and encounter search parameters. Later 312dae9b1544dff8b853b100b66c2d663eb0cee0 changed basedOn to a build-compatible Reference(Resource) representation while retaining the request-resource intent as comments.
additional_context: AuditEvent and Provenance are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Current source contains 0..* basedOn and 0..1 encounter on both resources, Event-pattern mappings, and active based-on and encounter search parameters. Workflow minutes record FHIR-28100 being reviewed and returned to Security, and Security minutes record it in an approved January 2021 block vote. FHIR-28101 was encountered because it was created in the same workflow meeting, but it concerns Provenance.entity role terminology and does not affect this issue.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the final accepted basedOn and encounter changes are already present and the absence of instantiates matches the narrowed resolution rather than a missing application.
